inspection_method: git object inspection after interrupted checkout left the working tree incomplete; inspected README, template, manual lint, PR template, README generator, code of conduct, and tracked file counts

anchors.why: Explains the goal: precise, formalized recipes for programmers; links website, Docker viewer, contribution instructions, tips, and generated recipe index.
Defines required title shape, difficulty, calories, sections, calculation formulas, ordered operations, additional content, and footer.
Validates filenames, required headings, difficulty/calorie lines, ordered operations, imprecise units, pronouns, footer, description length, image alt text, and file references.
Requires automated checks before human review and asks contributor to confirm licensing/public-domain status.
Walks Markdown files, groups categories, sorts entries, and regenerates README navigation from a template.
States the value of precision, formalization, machine readability, non-commercial posture, and derivative boundaries.

known_limits: The cooking corpus itself is not VAKS evidence.
The repository's public-domain/Unlicense policy is source-specific and should not become a VAKS default.
Strict lint is valuable for promotion or action-facing artifacts, but should not burden ordinary VAKS capture.
